data_quality_scan.gap_classification: Not all gaps are classified. No inference that every gap is missing data.

observed_continuous_instrument_rolls.source: Local Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1m MNQ.v.0 file instrument_id and symbol columns
observed_continuous_instrument_rolls.interpretation: Instrument-ID transitions are continuous-symbol roll attribution, not timestamp gaps; they are kept distinct from calendar closures and missing-bar claims.

certified_calendar_segments.scope: Labor Day halt and regular reopen only

classification_policy.scheduled_closures: Classify only from an explicit reviewed CME schedule snapshot.
classification_policy.holidays_and_early_closes: Require explicit date exceptions and source evidence; no inferred holiday template.
classification_policy.legitimate_no_trade_minutes: Remain unclassified absent trade-level evidence; OHLCV absence alone does not prove a scheduled closure.
classification_policy.genuine_missing_market_data: Only classify when a reviewed schedule says trading was open and the expected timestamp is absent.
classification_policy.contract_rolls: Use source symbology intervals/instrument IDs; never treat a roll as a time gap or combine contracts without validated mapping.

note: This is a coverage inventory, not a certificate that the full historical dataset is session-complete. Bounded bootstrap must fail closed unless its exact interval receives a complete verified coverage certificate.
